features.feature_value: Angry/uncivil tone reduced acceptance; perceived lack of respect led to removal.
features.evidence_span: the angry language used in the arguments
features.rationale: The participant explicitly links their decision to the emotional/angry language and disrespectful tone.

features.feature_value: Evaluated whether content was lies/propaganda and whether there was civil discourse vs insults.
features.evidence_span: Were they out and out lies? ... Was there any attempt at having a civil discourse?
features.rationale: They describe concrete criteria around factuality/propaganda and civility.

features.feature_value: Mentions whether insults were present as a salient influence on keep/remove.
features.evidence_span: Whether or not they contained insults.
features.rationale: This short reflection directly identifies insults as the deciding cue.

features.feature_value: Removed only the most egregious items, using past similar posts as a guide.
features.evidence_span: removed the ones that were absolutely egregious
features.rationale: They explicitly use an 'absolutely egregious' threshold informed by prior experience.

features.feature_value: Permissive about political views under free speech, except if threats or excessive bad language.
features.evidence_span: As long as there weren't threats or excessive bad language
features.rationale: They state a clear boundary condition for removal/keeping grounded in speech limits.

features.feature_value: Overall approval driven by belief in free speech, with at least one over-permission error.
features.evidence_span: I really believe in free speech so approved everything.
features.rationale: The participant attributes their broad approvals directly to free-speech belief.

features.feature_value: Even while leaning conservative, they chose removal of both parties' views for fairness.
features.evidence_span: to be fair I had to remove both parties views.
features.rationale: They describe a fairness rule applied across both sides rather than a one-sided political preference.

features.feature_value: Used an assumption that viewers can handle harsh statements if they can fact-check and think critically.
features.evidence_span: assuming the average viewer was a decent critically thinking human being
features.rationale: They explicitly reference assumptions about the audience's critical thinking/fact-checking in their evaluation process.
